title: The Recipe of the quarry
author: Marguerite Villalobos
blurb: Isandro Brightwater, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
